scope: The ten flagged experiment sets that any reading (first label set, blind repeat, or nonblinded second reading) classified as verified or ambiguous. Every reading classified the other 36 flagged sets as other.
material: Snapshot metadata of 26 September 2026 for each set, as given to the blind repeat readers (revision-2026-11-20-round2/blind_archive_inputs.json), presented without any AI labels in author_check/ARCHIVE_CHECK.md.
blinding_note: Before checking, the author had been told which five sets the AI readings classified as verified and which five as ambiguous, and that three of the ambiguous five were disputed. This is a confirmation check, not a blind reading.
author_statement: I made the check and I agree with the no readings for the three records that are ambiguous, and the other records I confirm the judgment of the AI reviewers.
outcome: Design labels: five verified and two ambiguous confirmed; the three disputed sets (00001204, 00001206, 00001240) classified as other. Alone-arm and ratio labels follow the AI readings the author confirmed; for the three other sets they follow the first and second readings (NA).
recorded_by: Transcribed from the author's statement by the AI assistant (Anthropic Claude) on 2026-11-22; the per-field values were not typed by the author.
